processing: Retain original marked VFR MP4 unchanged. Preserve all 241 decoded frames one-to-one at CFR24 using settb=1/24,setpts=N; no synthesized frames; duration increases about 25ms.
Central extraction at original coordinates and original HSV key, including dark saturated green; suppress green spill.
Only detached upper-right effect components are shrunk to 30% and moved from source centre (860,184) to (640,107); fade at 8.8-9.4s; assert all protected foreground pixels unchanged before encoding.
Original standing normalization, 640x360/24fps VP9 Alpha CRF18; no full-clip interpolation.
Fixed RGB curves calibrated against current idle, alpha unchanged before encoding; then nine-frame eased common-standing bridges without static hold.

localEffectRepair.protectedCharacter: Largest connected alpha>0 foreground component; all non-selected foreground pixels unchanged before encoding
localEffectRepair.effectSelection: After 2.5s, detached components with centroid x>=790 and bottom<=330; activate only after a component exceeds 500px
localEffectRepair.rawTimingPreparation: All 241 frames preserved at CFR24 using settb=1/24,setpts=N; no synthesized frames

colourMatch.method: Fixed RGB curves from opaque pale lavender material; anchors 0/64/255. Alpha and motion unchanged before encoding; apply common-standing bridges afterwards.

quality.reviewNotes: Reviewed twelve full-timeline samples, sixteen boundary samples, three times on black/white backgrounds and the idle/before/after colour comparison. Retains alternating glances, mild turns, hand clasp, small tiptoe, hourglass and neutral return. Timing is approximate: hourglass starts earlier than requested. Shrink and reposition only the detached hourglass/sparkles; character and all non-selected foreground pixels remain unchanged before effect encoding. White fluffy tail retained. Fixed RGB curves and short estimated standing bridges reduce brightness/pose mismatch; source drawing differences and minor bridge softness remain.
